How to Bake Lean: Double Chocolate High-Protein Cheesecake 🍫🍰

278 Calories • 20g Protein

Comment RECIPE and I’ll send it to you!

Follow @bakedlean for more baking tips and high-protein recipes. 🤝

Ingredients:
• 16 oz low-fat cream cheese, softened
• 2 cups fat-free cottage cheese
• 4 eggs
• 1 cup Splenda (or sweetener of choice)
• 2 scoops chocolate protein powder
• ¼ cup unsweetened cocoa powder
• Pinch of salt
• ¼ cup chocolate frosting

Directions:

1. Preheat oven to 325°F and line a 9-inch springform pan with parchment paper. Lightly spray the sides.
2. Blend the cream cheese, cottage cheese, eggs, sweetener, protein powder, cocoa powder, and salt until completely smooth.
3. Pour the batter into the prepared pan.
4. Microwave the chocolate frosting for 10–15 seconds until pourable. Drizzle over the batter and swirl with a knife.
5. Bake for 45–50 minutes until the edges are set and the center still has a slight jiggle.
6. Turn the oven off, crack the door, and let the cheesecake cool inside for 15–20 minutes.
7. Cool completely at room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 6 hours (overnight is best).
8. Slice into 8 servings and enjoy!

Bake Lean Tips:
• Blend the cottage cheese completely smooth for the creamiest texture.
• Don’t overbake—the center should still jiggle slightly.
• Let it cool slowly to help prevent cracks.
• Chill overnight for the cleanest slices.
